CREATE TABLE "public"."artifactFingerprint" (
  "artifactHash" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entryNames" json,
  "family" text,
  "fromVersionId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "sizeBytes" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."dealEvidence" (
  "body" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "roomId" text NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "dealEvidence_kind_check_8bbb8259" CHECK ("kind" IN ('MESSAGE', 'FILE', 'DELIVERY', 'DISPUTE_EVENT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."dealMessage" (
  "authorId" text NOT NULL,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "roomId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."dealRoom" (
  "amountMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "buyerId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'RUB' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "orderId" text,
  "sellerId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'CREATED' NOT NULL,
  "subjectId" text,
  "subjectType" text,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "dealRoom_status_check_693d2a50" CHECK ("status" IN ('CREATED', 'FUNDED', 'DELIVERING', 'DELIVERED', 'ACCEPTED', 'DISPUTED', 'RESOLVED', 'CLOSED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."demoSession" (
  "connectionInfo" json,
  "destroyedAt" timestamptz,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "failureReason" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "requestedById" text NOT NULL,
  "resourceId" text NOT NULL,
  "sandboxRef" text,
  "startedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'STARTING' NOT NULL,
  "ttlSeconds" int4 DEFAULT 1800 NOT NULL,
  "versionId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "demoSession_status_check_92305108" CHECK ("status" IN ('STARTING', 'RUNNING', 'EXPIRING', 'DESTROYED', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."favorite" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "targetId" text NOT NULL,
  "targetType" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "favorite_targetType_check_67e7260e" CHECK ("targetType" IN ('RESOURCE', 'SERVER', 'CREATOR', 'DISCUSSION'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."feedbackReport" (
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "handledById" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "resolutionNote" text,
  "route" text,
  "screenshotUrl" text,
  "severity" text DEFAULT 'MEDIUM' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'NEW' NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "feedbackReport_category_check_27522049" CHECK ("category" IN ('BUG', 'UX', 'BILLING', 'CONTENT', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "feedbackReport_severity_check_5e5a5e80" CHECK ("severity" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL')),
  CONSTRAINT "feedbackReport_status_check_62cac4db" CHECK ("status" IN ('NEW', 'TRIAGED', 'RESOLVED', 'DISMISSED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."leakCase" (
  "confidence" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "evidence" json,
  "evidenceCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "fingerprintId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "openedById" text NOT NULL,
  "resolutionNote" text,
  "resolvedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "leakCase_status_check_3fd459f7" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'CONFIRMED', 'DISMISSED', 'FALSE_POSITIVE', 'RESOLVED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."outboxEvent" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "availableAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "eventType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastError" text,
  "payload" json NOT NULL,
  "processedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "outboxEvent_status_check_8a5bce80" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'PROCESSED', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payoutRequest" (
  "amountMinor" int4 NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'RUB' NOT NULL,
  "decidedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ledgerTxnId" text,
  "note" text,
  "payoutRef" text,
  "requestedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "reviewedById" text,
  "sellerId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payoutRequest_status_check_c85a3565" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."priceAlert" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "events" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "resourceId" text NOT NULL,
  "targetPriceMinor" int4,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."subscription" (
  "autoRenew" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "graceUntil" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastPaymentId" text,
  "plan" text NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "subscription_plan_check_51533829" CHECK ("plan" IN ('CREATOR_PREMIUM', 'SERVER_PREMIUM', 'MARKETPLACE_PREMIUM', 'ADVERTISING_PREMIUM', 'ANALYTICS_PREMIUM')),
  CONSTRAINT "subscription_status_check_5106abed" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE', 'GRACE_PERIOD', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED'))
)
